title: M/S M.D. Ice And Cold Storage v. Executive Engineer (Prescribed Authority) DVVNL
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J.; Shashi Kant, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of with liberty to seek Clause 6.14 instalments; recovery to proceed.
headnote: A consumer facing a recovery certificate for electricity dues may approach the Executive Engineer for instalments under Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 if prepared to deposit; recovery itself proceeds in accordance with law. The writ seeking sympathetic consideration of a representation was disposed of with that liberty and without staying recovery.
facts: M/S M.D. Ice And Cold Storage, a cold-storage consumer of Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, faced outstanding electricity dues for which the Executive Engineer (Prescribed Authority) had issued a recovery certificate. The consumer filed a writ petition seeking that its pending representation be considered sympathetically. The Division Bench of the Allahabad High Court heard the matter on 18 April 2018.

holding_units.holding: Where a recovery certificate has issued for electricity dues, recovery proceeds in accordance with law, but a consumer prepared to deposit may approach the Executive Engineer for instalments as contemplated under Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether the consumer was entitled to instalments on the facts of the dues and recovery certificate
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.14 if the consumer is prepared to deposit
